title: Roasted Flounder with Cherry Tomatoes and Capers

items.item: olive oil (plus 2 tbsp more for drizzling)
salt (plus ½ tsp more for the fish)
pepper (plus ¼ tsp more for the fish)

instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees F. In a small bowl, combine cherry tomatoes, crushed garlic cloves, capers, balsamic vinegar, 3 tbsp olive oil, ¼ tsp salt, and ⅛ tsp pepper.
Transfer to a large roasting pan in a single layer and roast until the tomatoes begin to shrivel, 20 to 25 minutes.
Add flounder filets to the pan, resting the filets on the tomatoes. Season the filets with ½ tsp salt and ¼ tsp pepper. Drizzle with 2 tbsp olive oil. Sprinkle with fresh thyme leaves.
Bake until firm and opaque, about 10 minutes.
